decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias build directly on Plan Optik's core expertise in glass wafer structuring and bonding, so the firm can interpret early market feedback and improve the product through its own R&D and research cooperation in MEMS packaging.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller diameter wafers are a close, low-risk extension of the firm's existing glass wafer manufacturing knowledge and customer base, so it can easily absorb results and refine the product.
